verdict.rationale: Jan ships automation-like features: autonomous agents, custom assistants and browser automation via MCP. Versioning, reviewing and rolling back automations is therefore a fair question for it, but the evidence documents no version history, diffing or rollback for assistants or agent tasks. Per-tool-call approval panels are an adjacent runtime control, not review or rollback of an automation's definition.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
